out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: -Duty of PIC, Report to Health Department, Diagnosed Illness
violations.observation: The person in charge did not notify the regulatory authority that a food employee was diagnosed with an illness due to Norovirus, Hepatitus A virus, Shigella, E. Coli, Salmonella Typhi or nontyphoidal Salmonella.
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge shall notify the regulatory authority when a food employee was diagnosed with an illness due to Norovirus, Hepatitus A virus, Shigella, E. Coli, Salmonella Typhi or nontyphoidal Salmonella. CDI: EHS educated CFM on when to report food borne illnesses and symptoms (jaundice) to the health department.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the quat sanitizer solution was measured at above 400ppm at the 3 vat sink in the bar area. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of quat sanitizer solution at 200-300ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. CDI: CFM diluted quat sanitizer solution concentration with water until concentration is 250ppm. EHS instructed CFM to have quat sanitizer supplier (Ecolab) to recalibrate quat sanitizer solution dispenser so the quat sanitizer is between 200- 300ppm.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: cooked spaghetti noodles (51F), shelled pasta noodles (45F), and cooked fettuccine noodles (72F) cooling in 3 DWR stacked refrigerator on prepline.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. CDI: CFM relocated the container of cooked spaghetti, shelled pasta noodles, and fettuccine noodles to the walk in refrigerator to properly cool to 41F or below.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the mold like debris on ceiling over the high temperature dish machine and is not maintained in good repair. Accumulation of steam from the high temperature dish machine may be contributing.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS instructed CFM to schedule removal of mold on ceiling tile in the waste washing area.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: rubber spatula stored in container of standing water (92F) on the cookline.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CDI: CFM washed, rinsed, and sanitized the metal container before refilling with boiling water. Metal container of water will be stored on flat grill to ensure water maintains temperature of 135F or above.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed missing ceiling tiles over bread warmer and near walk in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS instructed CFM to replace missing ceiling tiles.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at handwashing sink located at front expo area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: CFM placed paper towels at hand sink.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: Observed multiple TCS food items (tomatoes, sauces, cheeses) on time as a public health control stored on the cold well along the cookline without 4 hour time stamp.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CDI: CFM placed time stamp for TCS food items for remaining time of 3 hours (11:00a- 3:00p).

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: metal ice scooped severely chipping.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. CDI: CFM replaced damaged metal ice scooped with new scoop.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, 4 Hour Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed spaghetti overfilled in refrigeration unit over the edges of the container. Foods were contacting the frame of the refrigerator- upon discussion with PIC, the refrigerator is not cleaned at a sufficient frequency to allow food contact.
violations.corrective_action: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils must be cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours to prevent contamination by bacterial growth.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked sausages (124F) in hot holding unit.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Food was discarded. Olive Garden Italian Restaurant 1361 (Inspection Date: 03/18/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: milk (44-45F) in 3 Dr bar cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. TCS foods were discarded from the unit (including whipped cream)

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: HACCP Plan, Records of Critical Limits
violations.observation: Records demonstrating the monitoring of the critical control points are not being retained. EHS observed logs from March 3-14, 2025. -Hot holding logs are incomplete and temperatures are generally not recorded from 2-5pm. -cooling logs show incomplete temperature records for cooling, observed Toscana soup with a 2 hour cooling temperature of 69F. -Cooling logs are not accurately recording the TIME that the temperatures are taken.
violations.corrective_action: Compliance with your HACCP Plan and record maintenance are critical to the cook-chill and reheating process approved by the Health Department. It is recommended to conduct staff training on the expectations for HACCP records.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Sanitizer Solution Stored off floor; No Food Contamination
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloth buckets improperly stored on the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloth buckets containing chemical sanitizing solutions shall not be stored on the floor. The wet towel buckets shall also be used in a manner that prevents contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 3-door bar refrigerator holding at 44-45F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that boxes of single I use utensils were stored on the floor in the down stairs storage room where there could be exposed to contamination.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. THE BOXES WERE RELOCATED OFF THE FLOOR DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections of the hand washing sink on the cold water faucet piping are leaking, at the Wait station in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. REPAR THE LEAKING COLD WATER PIPING/FAUCET
